answer: The harbor edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 122 clones produces a signature the nadir analysis flags immediately. Someone must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, so that doing work rather than printing keys, and the ledge settlement applies the void retroactively. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
